variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.body: The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: An expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.body: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.body: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
